thread:
sam-observability: Drafted follow-up for the 03/22 "aggregation skew" incident. Root symptoms: batches dropped at aggregator reorder + ETL consumer lagging during burst. Need owners, concrete remediations, and a short verification plan.

jess-ops: can we get owners assigned today? This pattern has shown up 2 other times in last 6 weeks.

li-eng: I can own the aggregator-side investigation. First step: diff the recent aggregator config + check the shard assignment code path. ETA: Tue EOD (2026-03-24).

tina-sre: I will own ETL consumer resilience (retries, commit window) and the temporary mitigation. Proposal: increase consumer_instances 3->6 for 8 hours around peak, and add per-tenant lag alert. Drafting PR. ETA: Thu (2026-03-26).

sam-observability: Uploaded the anomaly query I used to estimate missing spans and skew by tenant. Quick result: ~38k missing spans in 24h, concentrated on tenant:acme and tenant:beta.

jess-ops: created OBS-2034 and added owners. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-2034

li-eng: my plan: reproduce locally with replay of the 2026-03-22 traffic sample, run aggregator under the v2 config flag, and validate reorder logic. If repro succeeds, I'll prepare a canary with 5% traffic and a rollback flag. Need approval for canary deploy.

tina-sre: I'll approve post-CI if smoke tests show no delta >0.5% for sampled tenants. Also adding a short-lived alert: etl_consumer_lag > 120s for 5m triggers page.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created by li-eng for canary to 5% traffic. CI pipeline started.

sam-observability: For backfill, proposing two waves: (1) shallow verification pass to reconcile counts for top 10 tenants overnight (non-disruptive), (2) deeper backfill for the rest next weekend with rate-limited workers. I'll own execution.

jess-ops: booked Friday 11:00 sync to hand off backfill runbook and confirm mitigation. Invite sent. Also scheduling daily check-ins for one week.

li-eng: added a metric candidate: aggregator_reorder_events and aggregator_reorder_rate per minute. Will add Grafana panel + alert if rate > 5/min for 10m. PR coming with canary.

sam-observability: added a smoke test to the repo: assert ingested_count ~= aggregated_count within 0.5% for sampled set. Will wire alert on drift >0.75%.

tina-sre: note: if consumer lag persists under temp mitigation, we should evaluate durable queueing or persistent offsets. I'll put tradeoff doc in OBS-2034.

li-eng: rollback playbook will include: flip v2-config flag, scale aggregator down to previous instance count, and run quick reconcile job.

jess-ops: marking owners and due dates in OBS-2034. We will reconvene after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
